name: fitqun_sample_sk_wand_test
_comment: 3 MeV electron bomb, per scattab_nuPRISM_mPMT.mac. One electron per event, isotropic, msc inactivated, vertex uniform in the cylinder out to R - r_pmt (scatTableLooper's table domain). Feeds BOTH the angular response and the indirect-light tables, as the reference reuses one production for both.
_sizing: 250 jobs x 400k events = 1e8 electrons, matching the reference. ~3.5 h/job (53 min PhotonSim + 2.6 h propagation) at the measured 8 ms/event and 23.7k photons/s, and ~7 GB of scratch for the ROOT, deleted once the shard exists.
